references.text: The Levites received no inheritance among the tribes of Israel, for the priesthood of the Lord was their inheritance.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance with their brothers; the Lord himself is their inheritance.
The Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no inheritance among Israel. They shall live from the Lord's offerings.
Only to the tribe of Levi did Moses give no inheritance. The fire offerings of the Lord, the God of Israel, are their inheritance.
To the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance. The Lord, the God of Israel, is their inheritance.
Moses gave the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, to the children of Gad, the children of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Description of the land east of the Jordan given to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Reuben and Gad had received their inheritance from Moses on the east side of the Jordan.
Moses had given an inheritance to the two and a half tribes on the other side of the Jordan, but the Levites received no inheritance among them.
